title: Nonlinear Feedback in Josephson Circuit Optimization: Application to a Kerr-Reversal JTWPA
summary: Optimizing Josephson-based nonlinear microwave devices is computationally demanding because the straightforward approach requires exploring broad circuit parameter spaces through expensive nonlinear simulations. Josephson Circuits Optimizer addresses this problem by using harmonic balance simulations in two stages: fast linear simulations to select promising circuit configurations according to properties such as impedance and phase matching, followed by nonlinear simulations to optimize their operating conditions.
